title: Agent loop emits Codex-style item lifecycle stream events

behavior.title: Assistant deltas are emitted before final text
behavior.test: The agent loop must emit item lifecycle and text delta events while the model response is still active instead of only emitting final model_text.

steps.instruction: Inspect model and agent loop stream event types after implementation.
steps.expected: ModelClient supports an optional stream method and AgentEvent contains item_started, agent_message_delta, and item_completed event types.

steps.instruction: Inspect runtime event forwarding after implementation.
steps.expected: AgentRuntime forwards item lifecycle and delta events to RuntimeEvent messages without treating every delta as persisted final history.

behavior.passCriteria: The loop can surface streaming progress before the final assistant message is returned.

behavior.title: Tool call follow-up behavior is preserved
behavior.test: Streaming support must not break the existing model tool call -> worker execution -> function_call_output -> follow-up sampling cycle.

steps.instruction: Run yarn build from the repository root after implementation.

behavior.passCriteria: The TypeScript build succeeds with existing tool-call contracts intact.

documentation.title: Streaming event contract is documented
documentation.test: Package docs must explain that final return value and in-turn event stream are separate contracts.

steps.instruction: Inspect packages/ndx/docs/api.md, internals.md, and testing.md after implementation.
steps.expected: Docs describe model stream events, runtime item lifecycle events, final return semantics, and the agenttest suite.

documentation.passCriteria: Docs contain the streaming event contract and verification reference.

deployment.title: Deploy verification completes
deployment.test: The repository deploy contract must still complete after streaming event changes.

steps.instruction: Run npm run deploy from the repository root after implementation.
steps.expected: The command exits successfully or the failure is recorded with concrete blocker evidence.

deployment.passCriteria: Deploy succeeds, or any failure is recorded with command output and an explicit blocker.
